items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: And then in the Sands one year, one summer, one whole summer we had Jackie and Roy opposite.

ctx.x: He and this Virginia Moore and Jackie Sherrick Shererard, there names just came to me, were from Columbus, Ohio. She was very small, and the authorities used to come, thinking she was a young girl, and yet she had a degree from Ohio State University.
